      (local.set $q (i64.div_u (local.get $am) (local.get $bm)))
      (local.set $r (i64.rem_u (local.get $am) (local.get $bm)))
      (if (i32.eq (local.get $op) (i32.const 3))
        (then
          (local.set $n (i32.xor (local.get $an) (local.get $bn)))
          (if (i32.and (local.get $n) (i64.ne (local.get $r) (i64.const 0)))
            (then (local.set $q (i64.add (local.get $q) (i64.const 1)))))
          (return (call $faber_x_clamp (local.get $q) (local.get $n) (i32.const 0) (local.get $rbits) (local.get $rsigned)))))
      (if (i64.eqz (local.get $r))
        (then (return (i64.const 0))))
      (if (i32.eq (local.get $an) (local.get $bn))
        (then (return (call $faber_x_clamp (local.get $r) (local.get $bn) (i32.const 0) (local.get $rbits) (local.get $rsigned)))))
      (call $faber_x_clamp (i64.sub (local.get $bm) (local.get $r)) (local.get $bn) (i32.const 0) (local.get $rbits) (local.get $rsigned)))
    (func $faber_x_store (param $v i64) (param $vu i32) (param $rbits i32) (param $rsigned i32) (param $policy i32) (result i64)
      (if (i32.eq (local.get $policy) (i32.const 1))
        (then
          (if (i32.lt_u (local.get $rbits) (i32.const 64))
            (then
              (if (local.get $rsigned)
                (then (return (i64.shr_s
                  (i64.shl (local.get $v) (i64.extend_i32_u (i32.sub (i32.const 64) (local.get $rbits))))
                  (i64.extend_i32_u (i32.sub (i32.const 64) (local.get $rbits)))))))
              (return (i64.and (local.get $v)
                (i64.sub (i64.shl (i64.const 1) (i64.extend_i32_u (local.get $rbits))) (i64.const 1))))))
          (return (local.get $v))))
      (if (i32.eq (local.get $policy) (i32.const 2))
        (then
          (return (call $faber_x_clamp (call $faber_x_mag (local.get $v) (local.get $vu))
            (call $faber_x_neg (local.get $v) (local.get $vu)) (i32.const 0) (local.get $rbits) (local.get $rsigned)))))
      (call $faber_x_pack (call $faber_x_mag (local.get $v) (local.get $vu))
        (call $faber_x_neg (local.get $v) (local.get $vu)) (local.get $rbits) (local.get $rsigned)))
    (func $faber_x_cmp (param $a i64) (param $au i32) (param $b i64) (param $bu i32) (result i32)
      (local $an i32) (local $bn i32)
      (local.set $an (call $faber_x_neg (local.get $a) (local.get $au)))
      (local.set $bn (call $faber_x_neg (local.get $b) (local.get $bu)))
      (if (i32.ne (local.get $an) (local.get $bn))
        (then (return (select (i32.const -1) (i32.const 1) (local.get $an)))))
      (if (local.get $an)
        (then
          (if (i64.lt_s (local.get $a) (local.get $b)) (then (return (i32.const -1))))
          (return (i64.gt_s (local.get $a) (local.get $b)))))
      (if (i64.lt_u (local.get $a) (local.get $b)) (then (return (i32.const -1))))
      (i64.gt_u (local.get $a) (local.get $b)))
    (func $faber_x_cmpf (param $a i64) (param $au i32) (param $f f64) (result i32)
      (local $whole f64) (local $frac f64) (local $wbits i64) (local $wu i32) (local $c i32)
      (if (f64.ne (local.get $f) (local.get $f)) (then (return (i32.const 2))))
      (if (f64.ge (local.get $f) (f64.const 18446744073709551616)) (then (return (i32.const -1))))
      (if (f64.lt (local.get $f) (f64.const -9223372036854775808)) (then (return (i32.const 1))))
      (local.set $whole (f64.trunc (local.get $f)))
      (local.set $frac (f64.sub (local.get $f) (local.get $whole)))
      (if (f64.ge (local.get $whole) (f64.const 9223372036854775808))
        (then
          (local.set $wbits (i64.trunc_f64_u (local.get $whole)))
          (local.set $wu (i32.const 1)))
        (else
          (local.set $wbits (i64.trunc_f64_s (local.get $whole)))))
      (local.set $c (call $faber_x_cmp (local.get $a) (local.get $au) (local.get $wbits) (local.get $wu)))
      (if (local.get $c) (then (return (local.get $c))))
      (if (f64.gt (local.get $frac) (f64.const 0)) (then (return (i32.const -1))))
      (select (i32.const 1) (i32.const 0) (f64.lt (local.get $frac) (f64.const 0))))
    (global $faber_x_site (mut i32) (i32.const -1))
    (global $faber_x_site_big (mut i32) (i32.const -1))
    (global $faber_x_site_neg (mut i32) (i32.const -1))
    (func $faber_x_store_t (param $v i64) (param $vu i32) (param $rbits i32) (param $rsigned i32) (param $tpl i32) (param $big i32) (param $negtpl i32) (result i64)
      (local $r i64)
      (global.set $faber_x_site (local.get $tpl))
      (global.set $faber_x_site_big (local.get $big))
      (global.set $faber_x_site_neg (local.get $negtpl))
      (local.set $r (call $faber_x_store (local.get $v) (local.get $vu) (local.get $rbits) (local.get $rsigned) (i32.const 0)))
      (global.set $faber_x_site (i32.const -1))
      (local.get $r))
    (func $faber_x_conv (param $v i64) (param $vu i32) (param $rbits i32) (param $rsigned i32) (result i64)
      (local $r i64)
      (global.set $faber_x_site (i32.const -2))
      (local.set $r (call $faber_x_store (local.get $v) (local.get $vu) (local.get $rbits) (local.get $rsigned) (i32.const 0)))
      (global.set $faber_x_site (i32.const -1))
      (local.get $r))
    (func $faber_x_f2i (param $f f64) (param $rbits i32) (param $rsigned i32) (result i64)
      (local $t f64) (local $half f64)
      (if (f64.ne (local.get $f) (local.get $f))
        (then (call $faber_x_trap (i32.const 4)) (unreachable)))
      (local.set $t (f64.trunc (local.get $f)))
      (local.set $half
        (f64.convert_i64_u (i64.shl (i64.const 1) (i64.extend_i32_u (i32.sub (local.get $rbits) (i32.const 1))))))
      (if (local.get $rsigned)
        (then
          (if (i32.or (f64.lt (local.get $t) (f64.neg (local.get $half))) (f64.ge (local.get $t) (local.get $half)))
            (then (call $faber_x_trap (i32.const 4)) (unreachable)))
          (return (i64.trunc_f64_s (local.get $t)))))
      (if (i32.or (f64.lt (local.get $t) (f64.const 0)) (f64.ge (local.get $t) (f64.mul (local.get $half) (f64.const 2))))
        (then (call $faber_x_trap (i32.const 4)) (unreachable)))
      (i64.trunc_f64_u (local.get $t)))
    (func $faber_x_trap (param $k i32)
      (if (i32.eq (local.get $k) (i32.const 0)) (then (call $__faber_rt_v1_assert_message (i32.const 0) (i32.const 4))))
      (if (i32.eq (local.get $k) (i32.const 1)) (then (call $__faber_rt_v1_assert_message (i32.const 0) (i32.const 3))))
      (if (i32.eq (local.get $k) (i32.const 2)) (then (call $__faber_rt_v1_assert_message (i32.const 0) (i32.const 2))))
      (if (i32.eq (local.get $k) (i32.const 3)) (then (call $__faber_rt_v1_assert_message (i32.const 0) (i32.const 5))))
      (if (i32.eq (local.get $k) (i32.const 4)) (then (call $__faber_rt_v1_assert_message (i32.const 0) (i32.const 0))))
      (if (i32.eq (local.get $k) (i32.const 5)) (then (call $__faber_rt_v1_assert_message (i32.const 0) (i32.const 1))))
      (unreachable))
    (func $faber_x_range_fail (param $mag i64) (param $neg i32)
      (local $h i32)
      (if (i32.eq (global.get $faber_x_site) (i32.const -2))
        (then (call $faber_x_trap (i32.const 3))))
      (if (i32.lt_s (global.get $faber_x_site) (i32.const 0))
        (then (call $faber_x_trap (i32.const 0))))
      (if (local.get $neg)
        (then (local.set $h (call $__faber_rt_v1_format_i64 (global.get $faber_x_site_neg) (i64.sub (i64.const 0) (local.get $mag)))))
        (else
          (if (i64.lt_s (local.get $mag) (i64.const 0))
            (then (local.set $h (call $__faber_rt_v1_format_i64_i64 (global.get $faber_x_site_big) (i64.div_u (local.get $mag) (i64.const 10)) (i64.rem_u (local.get $mag) (i64.const 10)))))
            (else (local.set $h (call $__faber_rt_v1_format_i64 (global.get $faber_x_site) (local.get $mag)))))))
      (call $__faber_rt_v1_assert_message (i32.const 0) (local.get $h))
      (unreachable))
)
